findings.desc: Coverage exercises captureMilestoneCloseoutSnapshotFromStore directly, but no test or smoke asserts the real story_advance --phase=DONE path writes milestone-closeout.json. A regression that removes the transition-orchestrator DONE wiring at packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:600 would leave the focused milestone-status tests green. Add an end-to-end or smoke test with a TEST story and confirmed ledger that runs story_advance DONE and asserts the closeout snapshot is captured before phase metadata/drift.
